scan.pinterest_status: Pinterest's official Newsroom, Business guidance and public 2026 design-trend board were checked on 12 October 2026. The newest official trend report remains the 6 October Beauty Trend Report, alongside the previously covered Visual Search Ads announcement. The public board remains at the same 395/396-pin retro-pop cluster reviewed on 11 October. No new durable visual system, production method or campaign behavior was distinct from the 717-command catalogue.
scan.chatgpt_status: Production v2.21.0 with 717 commands was read before the decision. No script or metadata change was materially justified. All 717 commands, 42 categories, 40 executable bundle mappings, personal creative intelligence, settings and Firefox updater controls remain unchanged. The live release passed 18 regression checks; browser installation remains locally observable only after userscript reload.
trends: the official Beauty Trend Report remains Pinterest’s newest trend report, with visual specificity and actionable reference decoding already covered by /beauty-trend-system
Visual Search Ads and product-led visual discovery remain active signals already covered by /visual-search-ready and product-ad controls
Q5 guidance continues to emphasize self-purchase, planning, utility, asset reuse and creative variety, already covered by /performance-creative-mix and /trend-to-brand
holiday optimization continues to favor multiple formats, five or more distinct creatives, clear products, lifestyle context and legible offers, already covered by /performance-creative-mix
the public design-trends board still centers retro food illustration, cartoon mascots, pop-art packaging, bold palettes and print texture, now covered by /retro-pop-branding
adjacent neon, synthwave, street-art, Bauhaus and thrift-poster references remain style cues rather than distinct command-level production systems
skipped: No new Beauty command because /beauty-trend-system already converts visible hair, nail and makeup features into identity-safe recreation, editorial, UGC and product-ad systems
No new Visual Search Ads command because /visual-search-ready already protects product identity, silhouette, hierarchy, contextual variants and purchase-intent metadata
No Q5 or holiday aliases because the durable strategy is already implemented by /performance-creative-mix, /trend-to-brand and existing product/social commands
No neon, synthwave, street-art, Bauhaus or thrift-poster aliases because these are covered as selectable art-direction cues and do not justify catalogue churn
No retro-pop changes because the public board’s visible cluster and pin counts were unchanged from the prior scan and /retro-pop-branding already captures the reusable system

test.detail: All 18 current-release regression checks passed: syntax; version sync; exact base and prior-trend preservation; command count, addition, removal and duplicate checks; /retro-pop-branding integrity; categories; bundles and references; metadata parity; monitor/runtime anchors; updater controls; settings/history compatibility; runtime closure.

deploy.detail: No userscript or metadata deployment was needed. The completed scan record was published to main with a blob-SHA conflict guard and refetched for exact verification. The unchanged v2.21.0 userscript and metadata were read from main before the decision. Browser installation is not claimed.
